newsitem.title: FRANCE: Camdessus hopes for Russia-IMF accord in Dec - source.
newsitem.headline: Camdessus hopes for Russia-IMF accord in Dec - source.

text.p: International Monetary Fund head Michel Camdessus said he hopes the IMF will be in a position to recommend a resumption of disbursements on an IMF loan in December if an improving trend in revenue collection continues, an international monetary source said on Thursday.
Camdessus made the comments to Russian reporters in Paris after meeting Russian Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin on Wednesday night.
Chernomyrdin, on a visit to Poland on Thursday, said earlier that the IMF was likely to resume its payments on its $10 billion loan from December 15.
The IMF delayed payments on the loan mostly because of worries about Russian tax collection.
Any recommendation to resume disbursements would be based on a review of policy performance in November.
Camdessus held some five hours of talks on Wednesday night with Chernomyrdin, who was on a two-day visit to Paris.
